name: Lootly Loyalty & Rewards
author: Lootly

sections.description:
Lootly – Loyalty, Rewards, Referrals & VIP for WooCommerce

Acquiring a new customer costs five times more than retaining an existing one. Lootly is a full-stack customer retention platform that gives WooCommerce merchants the tools to turn one-time buyers into repeat customers and loyal brand advocates, through Points & Rewards, Referral Programs, VIP Tiers, and Affiliate Marketing, all in one place.

A loyalty program is only as effective as its ability to keep customers coming back. Lootly is built specifically for that: driving repeat purchase behavior, increasing average order value, and deepening customer lifetime value through incentives that are meaningful, timely, and frictionless.

Seamless on-site experience, no extra accounts needed

Lootly automatically detects when a customer is logged in and displays their loyalty information directly within the on-site widget. No separate account, no extra friction.

Spotlight: Redeem rewards right in the cart

Customers can apply rewards without leaving checkout. Lootly’s in-cart redemption widget lets shoppers redeem points and apply discounts from the cart page, with automatic coupon application on click, no copy-paste required.

Choose between two widget types:

  • Fixed Rewards Dropdown – surfaces Available Rewards, My Rewards, VIP Rewards, and Referral Rewards in a clean, categorized view
  • Variable Points Slider – lets customers choose exactly how many points to spend on a given order

When merchants restrict rewards on sale or out-of-stock items in Lootly, the cart shows clear warnings on the dropdown and points slider (including Serbian and other supported languages) so customers know why a reward cannot be applied.

Spotlight: Auto-apply coupon codes from the widget and rewards page

No more copy-pasting. Lootly auto-applies reward coupon codes from the program widget and the rewards page, taking customers straight to a cart that is ready to checkout.

Spotlight: Free product rewards with variant support

Reward customers with free products, including full variant support (size, color, etc.), from the widget, rewards page, and Woo cart. Merchants can limit which variants are redeemable, so you can offer meaningful, personalized incentives without workarounds.

Launch in minutes. Scale without limits.

Lootly is designed to be feature-rich and fully accessible regardless of business size. Here’s what’s included across our plans:

  • Points & Rewards
  • Referral Program
  • VIP Tier Program
  • Affiliate Program
  • In-Cart Reward Redemption Widgets
  • Points expiration with reminders
  • Coupon expiration with customizable reminders
  • Free Product Rewards with Variants Support
  • Custom rewards with notification system
  • Custom API action to reward all possible customer behaviors
  • Email Customization & Custom Sender Domain
  • Earning & Spending Limits
  • Product, Category & Customer Segmentation
  • Full Design Customization in platform and with HTML Editors
  • Advanced Insights & Reports
  • Import & Export Customers
  • Integrations (Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, Attentive, and more)
  • And much more!

Visit https://lootly.io/pricing to explore all available plans and features.

The Lootly for WooCommerce plugin relies on lootly.io to handle all functionality. You must create an account at https://lootly.io/ to use this plugin.

  • Terms of Service: https://lootly.io/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://lootly.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install Lootly Loyalty & Rewards either via the WordPress.org plugin directory or by uploading the zip file to your WordPress Site.
  2. Once the app is installed, you will need to navigate to the “Lootly” menu on the left.
  3. The Lootly settings area requires that you enter in your Lootly Account Email, API Key & API Secret. You can obtain this information by accessing your Lootly account, then click on Account Settings (top right). Don’t have an account? No problem! Lootly has a free plan. You can visit Lootly by going to: Lootly
  4. After you’ve added your credentials click Verify, then click Save, and you’re done! You should now see the Lootly On-Site widget displaying on the right side of your website.
  5. You can change how this shows within your Lootly account, under: Display > Tab
sections.faq:
How does Lootly help my store?

Lootly offers over 12 ways for customers to participate in your loyalty program, such as: Sharing your brand on Facebook, reading your blog, writing a product review or celebrating a birthday.

Customers performing these actions can receive points, which helps to build loyalty with your brand, especially if you have a number of great rewards available to them. Customers can redeem points for rewards, such as $ off their next order or even Free Shipping.

Lootly also helps you build new sources of revenue by establishing a Referrals Program, to help turn happy customers into Brand Ambassadors.

How easy is this to setup?

Lootly is incredibly simple to install to your store, as it only takes a few clicks and less than 1 minute of your time. Once installed, our team is always available via Live Chat, Email or Phone for helping answer any questions you have.

What types of Plans does Lootly offer?

Lootly was built to be an affordable and feature rich solution for brands looking to launch a loyalty & rewards program. Visit us at https://lootly.io/pricing to better understand our pricing & features available.

Can I import my existing customers?

Yes! Lootly makes it incredibly easy to import all of your existing customers & award them points automatically for past purchases. Importing begins on our Growth $49 Plan.

What level of support is available?

Lootly is based in Orlando, FL and offers Live Chat, Email and Phone support. For brands looking for more personalized attention, we offer a Dedicated Account Manager on our Enterprise Plan.
